title: A Theory on Flow Matching with Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.10089v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, we develop theoretical foundation for flow matching with neural-network-parameterized conditional velocity fields. We establish convergence guarantees for gradient descent in the over-parameterized 2-layered ReLU neural network regime. We derive generalization bounds for the conditional velocity-field matching objective. Building on these results, we provide Wasserstein-distance guarantees for the samples generated by the induced flow. Our analysis is based on generalization bound for multi-task representation learning with unbounded losses, which may be of independent interest beyond flow-based generative modeling. These theoretical results are validated through extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world image benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/qishuoyin/FlowMatchNN.

translated_title: 神经网络流匹配的理论研究
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们为基于神经网络参数化条件速度场的流匹配建立了理论基础。我们在过参数化的两层ReLU神经网络机制下建立了梯度下降的收敛性保证，并推导了条件速度场匹配目标的泛化界。基于这些结果，我们为诱导流生成的样本提供了Wasserstein距离保证。我们的分析基于具有无界损失的多任务表示学习的泛化界，这一结果在基于流的生成建模之外也可能具有独立的研究价值。这些理论结果通过在合成数据和真实世界图像基准上的大量实验得到了验证。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/qishuoyin/FlowMatchNN 获取。
tldr: 该论文为神经网络参数化的流匹配建立了首个理论基础，证明了过参数化两层ReLU网络梯度下降的收敛性、速度场匹配的泛化界以及生成样本的Wasserstein距离保证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first theoretical foundation for neural-network-parameterized flow matching, proving convergence of gradient descent in over-parameterized 2-layer ReLU networks, generalization bounds for velocity-field matching, and Wasserstein-distance guarantees for generated samples.
